Fateful tissue — biology decides when the tissue divides

Every scale at once: a tyssue of dividing cells; inside each, a Smoldyn particle sim (dark dots, split on division); inside each, an ODE metabolism whose metabolite C pins a MaBoSS fate network. A cell divides when its own fate network raises divide — so the tissue's divisions are decided by the metabolism→fate chain, not a clock.
